flags.note: The testimonial already carries all three C1 elements, clearly and prominently, directly under the quote in the same post: current client status and tenure ('a current client of Brindlecombe Wistow and has been since 2017'), non-compensation ('not paid or given anything of value'), and the material conflict ('Her son, Daniel Ogunbiyi, is a relationship manager at the firm, which gives her a personal reason to speak favorably of us'), with the conflicted person named and the nature of the bias explained. The flag faults the draft for not saying how the conflict was 'addressed or mitigated,' but C1 requires disclosure of a material conflict, not a description of mitigation or remediation measures. No checklist gap here, and this does not correspond to either unmatched known issue (p2 C4 cherry-picked window, p3 C3 missing 1/5/10-year periods).
